analysis.title: Woodward Inc. (WWD): Remains one of the best long-term growth stories in the industry; Buy
key_insights: GS keeps Woodward at Buy after F4Q26. The thesis rests on aerospace, defense and industrial component content gains on next-generation aircraft and engines, exposure to the power build-out, and margin opportunity.

F4Q26 adjusted EPS was $2.83 against FactSet consensus of $2.54. Total revenue was 1.5% above consensus. Segment operating margin was 23.2%, 85 bps above consensus, and segment EBIT was 5% above consensus.
Aerospace aftermarket revenue rose 25% y/y, Aerospace OE rose 26%, Defense aftermarket fell 12%, and Defense OE rose 11%.
GS says the growth drivers are still early. LEAP is in the early years of engine aftermarket with decades of visibility, and the power build-out is early.
FY2027 guidance: total revenue +6-10% (consensus 8.8%), Aerospace +8-13% with a 23.8-24.3% margin, Industrial +1-5% with an 18.2-18.7% margin. EPS guide is $10.20-$10.70 against consensus of $10.74.
FY2027 free cash flow guidance is $400-450mn against consensus of $499mn. Capex guidance is $290mn against consensus of $232mn.
GS argues WWD guides conservatively, so giving the initial guide for next year can act as a clearing event.
Valuation is close to the average of GS's aerospace supply chain coverage, despite what GS calls a stronger than average multi-year fundamental story.
Versus GS's estimates, F4Q26 Aerospace EBIT margin was 24.3% (30 bps below) and Industrial EBIT margin was 20.7% (240 bps above, up 610 bps y/y).
F4Q26 free cash flow was $131mn against $181mn a year ago. Cash was $522mn and net debt/EBITDA was 1.0X.
GS cut FY27E revenue to $4,785.7mn from $4,834.0mn and raised FY26 EPS basis. FY27E EPS moves to $11.12 from $11.34, FY28E to $13.48 from $13.44, FY29E to $15.93 from $15.66.
12-month price target rises to $487 from $478, based on 27.5X 2027E EV/EBITDA (unchanged). Price is $335.72, implying 45.1% upside.

market_movers.rationale: F4Q26 beat consensus on EPS and segment margin, and GS sees early-stage growth drivers in LEAP aftermarket and the power build. Price target moves to $487 from $478 on a 27.5X 2027E EV/EBITDA multiple.

sector_views.rationale: GS rates WWD Buy on content gains on next-generation aircraft and engines, and sees valuation near the average of its aerospace supply chain coverage.
